headlines.summary:

The demand from Singapore was likely to remain steady in the coming months, given that the prices of office assets have declined by as much as 50 per cent, according to Thomas Chak, head of capital markets and investment services at the property...

headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际数据显示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产的最大非本地买家群体，受惠于香港写字楼市场低迷期间不良资产价格大幅回调的吸引。鉴于写字楼资产价格仍处低位，未来数月新加坡资金需求预计将保持稳定。

headlines.title: 瑞银CEO认为未来市场将继续出现波动性“飙升”
headlines.summary: 瑞银集团首席执行官Sergio Ermotti在接受采访时表示，他预计今年剩余时间里“波动性飙升”还将继续。“从宏观形势、地缘政治局势、当前的争论，以及我们在股市中看到的巨大分化来看，能源价格面临的压力可能会给通胀带来潜在的逆风”。Ermotti表示投资者不会喜欢这种波动，“我确实预计在今年剩余时间里波动性将继续飙升”。

headlines.title: 外交部回应美国实施先进机器人进口限制
headlines.summary: 针对美国联邦通信委员会宣布对外国制造的先进机器人实施进口限制，包括中方占有主导地位的人形机器人，外交部发言人毛宁7月29日在例行记者会上说，中方一贯坚决反对美方泛化国家安全概念打压中国企业。保护主义提升不了美国的竞争力，只会损害美国企业和消费者的利益。中方将继续采取必要措施，坚定维护中国企业的正当合法权益。（新华社）

headlines.title: 商务部办公厅：进一步加力推动城市一刻钟便民生活圈建设
headlines.summary: 商务部办公厅印发关于进一步加力推动城市一刻钟便民生活圈建设的工作通知。通知提出，各地要加快工作进度，划定便民生活圈总量，明确逐年建设数量，按照有关规划安排，在保证质量的前提下，2026年完成全国建设1万个便民生活圈的既定目标。各地要依托便民生活圈开展丰富多彩的惠民促销活动，推动国货“潮品”、外贸优品、本地精品、国际名品进社区，依法依规设置展区展台，丰富社区消费场景。要鼓励家电以旧换新、数码和智能产品购新补贴政策参与主体，在社区举办宣传促销活动，引导生产、销售、平台、售后服务和回收企业在社区设立便民服务点。要鼓励汽车生产、流通、回收企业在社区宣传汽车以旧换

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce Office: Further efforts to accelerate construction of 15-minute community convenience living circles
headlines.summary_en: The General Office of the Ministry of Commerce issued a notice on further promoting the construction of 15-minute community convenience living circles. The notice called for local authorities to accelerate progress, set a total number of living circles, and specify annual construction targets. Under relevant plans, the national goal of building 10,000 convenience living circles should be completed by 2026, with quality ensured. Localities should leverage these living circles to organize diverse promotional activities for public benefit, bringing domestic 'trendy products,' high-quality foreign trade goods, local specialties, and international brands into communities, setting up exhibition areas in accordance with laws and regulations to enrich community consumption scenarios. Entities involved in appliance trade-in programs and subsidies for digital and smart product purchases should be encouraged to hold promotional events in communities, guiding manufacturers, sellers, platforms, after-sales service providers, and recyclers to set up service points in communities. Automakers, distributors, and recyclers should also be encouraged to promote car trade-ins in communities.

headlines.title: 东阳光在北京成立未来实验室科技公司，注册资本1亿

headlines.title_en: HEC establishes Beijing Future Lab Technology Company with registered capital of 100 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: According to Tianyancha App, Dongxu Future Laboratory Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. was recently established, with legal representative Zhou Lin and a registered capital of 100 million yuan. The business scope includes AI application software development, intelligent robot R&D, industrial robot manufacturing, and intelligent robot sales. It is wholly owned by Guangdong Dongxu Science & Technology Holding Co., Ltd. (Interface News).
